CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 6
   C. 16
   D. 10

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

4. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 48

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 8

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 18

13. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 24

15. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
